## Requirements: Pages exact-HEAD PR review observation (Phase 2-B4 of #1782)

The standalone public Pages already validates current PR HEAD → CI/E2E GitHub Actions Run+attempt (#1834), and it displays bounded Issue Timeline PR cross-references (#1837). However, **Review** is absent. This slice adds a conservative source-backed review event, not the full Issue → implementing PR → Agent lineage.

- During trusted read-only build, fetch at most 100 GitHub PR reviews per displayed open PR (at most 12 PRs); no browser token or private APIs. Fail closed on API errors, truncation, malformed values, and source drift.
- Publish only a bounded, allowlisted **latest observed review event whose `commit_id` matches the exact current PR HEAD SHA**; validate same-repository PR identity and canonical GitHub source review link. Do not infer aggregate approval/merge readiness from one review event. Dismissed/COMMENTED reviews are **not** Pass; past-HEAD APPROVED reviews are not current approvals.
- Show source status `available / truncated / unavailable`, exact HEAD prefix and review state or `Not observed` on the independent `#/work` view; do not confuse an incomplete snapshot with no historical reviews.
- Deterministic positive/negative fixtures cover old SHA approvals, forged review links, invalid IDs, review states, missing/truncated responses, duplicate/out-of-order events, and leaked user/private data.
- Preserve `pages/` ↔ `web/` absolute isolation, read-only orphan access, and existing `pages-overview` / `pages-evidence` regression. Parent #1782 SCs remain pending until separate canonical acceptance; this slice does not claim Agent causality, SC Acceptance, or #1690 Run Store integrity.

### Success Criteria
- [ ] SC-01 Build-only bounded same-repo PR Review API ingestion with exact PR HEAD SHA binding, canonical review URL, stable deterministic event choice and honest unavailable/truncated coverage.
- [ ] SC-02 Independent Pages Work UI shows the latest observed exact-head review event or Not observed, never claims historical APPROVED as current Pass or overall PR approval.
- [ ] SC-03 Versioned allowlist/export release gate and deterministic negative security/drift/order/cap fixtures reject forged/malformed data and private fields.
- [ ] SC-04 Standalone Pages CI, Quality, Case Smoke, selected E2E and exact-head Acceptance all pass; no product `web/` coupling or privileged writer changes.
